reasoning: The landscape plan shows multiple trees (marked as "M" for Mitigation Trees) positioned directly on or within 20 feet of the overhead electric (OHE) line that runs along the southern boundary of the site. Per UCM § 1.10.10.4, distribution clearances require trees to be: (a) only utility-compatible species within 15 lateral feet of distribution conductors, (b) utility-compatible or mature height < 40 feet within 15-25 lateral feet, or (c) any tree beyond 25 lateral feet. I need to measure the actual lateral distances from tree trunk centers to the OHE line to determine if any trees violate clearance requirements. The grouping specifies measurement from trunk center to outside conductor.

applicableChecklistItems.checklist_deficiency_text: Non-utility-compatible trees proposed within 15 lateral feet of overhead electric distribution conductor or equipment
Large trees (mature height 40+ feet per ECM Appendix F) proposed within 25 lateral feet of overhead electric distribution conductor or equipment
